text:
olivia: kicking off a controlled canary for the v2->v1 proxy mapping now, 10% traffic. pushing gateway shim, no client opt-in required. release notes: https://intranet.redwood/release/2026/v2-proxy-shim

deploy-bot: deploy started by olivia at 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z, canary=10%, targets=api-gateway,proxy-shim:v2->v1

samir: ack, watching latency and 5xx. will run synthetic smoke against common routes (/generate, /chat)

marco: noticed v1 header passthrough is slightly different for tool-calls. added a quick transform in the shim, pushing fix now. log: `WARN shim: missing x-rw-tool`

jenna: pinging platform clients slack channel — tagging top 10 integrators. if anyone sees errors please @samir and tag the thread

kai: quick check — can we pin mobile SDK to header gate so older clients don't get the new routing? we should avoid mass fallbacks

olivia: good call. applying client-pin rule for mobile-sdk <= 1.8.3 to remain on v1 path. doing policy update (will propagate in ~2m)

infra-bot: routing-policy update applied: client.pin mobile-sdk<=1.8.3 -> route:v1 (propagation 120s)

samir: running smoke now: `curl -s -X POST /chat -d '{"msg":"smoke"}' | jq .status` — 200s on canary nodes, p95 slightly up +40ms but within SLO

marco: after shim fix, tool-call flow tests passed locally. pushing e2e to canary cluster (build 6543)

deploy-bot: canary health: 10% traffic, errors: 0.12% (baseline 0.08%), avg latency +38ms. auto-escalation threshold 0.5% or +200ms

olivia: decision time in 10m. if no regression and infra/qa thumbs up, we move to 50% then 100%. if errors creep above threshold we rollback to v1 routing and revert shim

samir: putting a synthetic run every 30s and streaming logs to #eng-release-observability. will call rollback if errors >0.5% for 3 consecutive 1m windows

jenna: drafting release note blurb for customers about graceful routing and pinning behavior. will include rollback plan & opt-out steps

marco: small note — some legacy webhook clients rely on original x-rw-trace header ordering. I added reorder in shim; monitoring for any downstream JSON parsing issues

infra-bot: propagation complete for policy and shim rollout. canary metrics stabilizing

olivia: thumbs? :thumbsup: to advance to 50% in 5m, otherwise we hold and investigate

kai: :thumbsup: from platform side

samir: :thumbsup: from infra monitoring

deploy-bot: schedule: after approval, will shift to 50% at 2026-03-20T15:06:00Z, then to 100% in 15m if stable

olivia: proceeding to 50% now. tagging postmortem owner in case of issues @marco

deploy-bot: rollout progressed: 50% complete. canary metrics: errors 0.11%, avg latency +35ms

marco: e2e on canary cluster passed all tool-call, webhook, and embedded-client tests

jenna: customer comms update sent to integrators list, include rollback contact + support playbook

samir: continuing sweeps, will report after 10m. if anything spikes we abort and pin clients back to v1

olivia: thanks team. leaving watch open for 30m then finalize notes for next release digest. remember to file any anomalies in #postmortems if we see regressions

deploy-bot: rollout complete: 100% traffic migrated to new proxy shim at 2026-03-20T15:21:40Z. no automated rollback triggered.

olivia: closing thread — successful rollout. follow-ups: formalize header-change in SDK migration guide, and add an opt-in flag for early adopters.

jenna: filing release notes + changelog entry now.

marco: created follow-up ticket INF-1974 to add more header-compat tests

samir: monitoring continues for 24h, will alert if anything degrades

olivia: great work everyone :tada:
